name: Taplio
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Taplio, plan LinkedIn content and maintain a manual relationship follow-up list. The hard boundary is linkedin data, inspiration feed, scheduling, relationship workflows, and analytics, plus api access, connector upkeep, and collaboration.
